QUEUE_DISABLED: Report export requires the queue. Set REPORT_QUEUE_ENABLED=true and run the worker process.
JOB_NOT_FOUND: Report job not found (it may have passed the 24-hour retention)
NOT_READY: The report is not finished or has failed — check the job status before downloading
FILE_GONE: The report file is no longer in storage (cleaned up after 24 hours)
